11. Checklist & Common Mistakes

11.1 Checklist — New Module

#StepCheck Command
1Folder createdls templates/abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/
2module.json validpython3 -m json.tool templates/abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/module.json
3module.json id = folder namegrep '"id"' module.json
4index.html existsls templates/abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/index.html
5base.html is extendedhead -1 index.html
6Service restartedsupervisorctl restart abpe-django
7Module visible in sidebarBrowser → Check sidebar
8Route reachablecurl -I http://localhost/mein_modul/
9i18n loadedBrowser Console: 📚 Loading language: de [mein_modul]
10Texts translated DE/EN/FRSwitch language in header
11Dark mode worksTheme button → Dark
12Mobile layout okBrowser DevTools → 375px
13Backup madepython backup_restore.py -save ... -m "New Module"

11.2 Common Mistakes

ErrorCauseSolution
Module not in sidebarenabled: false or JSON errorpython3 -m json.tool module.json
Module in sidebar but 404Route in module.json wrongroute must end with /
Template not foundWrong template pathPath must be abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/index.html
CSS not loadedPath in static.css wrongRelative to css/: mod/mod-mein_modul.css
JS not loadedPath in static.js wrongRelative to js/: mod/mod-mein_modul.js
Texts not translatedloadLanguage() missingIn extra_js block: loadLanguage('{{ current_lang }}', 'mein_modul')
data-i18n shows keyKey not in JSONCheck JSON structure and key path
Toggle does not opennextElementSibling wrongsection-content must directly follow section-header
Dark mode breaksColors hardcodedReplace all colors with CSS variables
500 Server ErrorPython error in view/templatejournalctl -u abpe-django -n 50
CSRF error on POSTX-CSRFToken missingUse getCsrf() function in JS
collectstatic forgottenNew files not foundpython manage.py collectstatic --noinput

11.3 Debug Tips

# View Django errors
journalctl -u abpe-django -n 100 --no-pager

# Check template syntax
python manage.py check

# Check JSON syntax
python3 -m json.tool datei.json

# Check static files
python manage.py collectstatic --noinput --dry-run

# Debug ModuleScanner
python3 -c "
import django, os
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'abpe.settings')
django.setup()
from apps.abpe_ui.core.module_scanner import ModuleScanner
for m in ModuleScanner().modules:
    print(m['id'], m.get('enabled'))
"
